messages:
Maya: Quick: we need a single-page gated brief for webinar follow-up that compares Hosted / Dedicated / Private for security-conscious buyers. Must be scannable, include one benchmark callout, clear inbound routing rules, and two A/B messaging variants. Draft by EOD tomorrow.

Len: I9ll do the comparison table and the SLA line. Keep it to 3 rows: p99 latency, unit cost/1M tokens, and control/compliance notes.

Priya: I9ll write the two messaging variants: Variant A = exec-first (risk/ROI), Variant B = platform-first (dev velocity + observability). Each variant 3 bullets.

Gabe: Benchmark nugget (from bench):
Hosted p99 = 140ms (~$9 / 1M tokens)
Dedicated p99 = 85ms (~$5 / 1M tokens, reserved)
Private p99 = 100ms (~$6.5 / 1M tokens, infra-dependent)
Footnote: model-mid, seq=3072, mixed prompts, 5k samples.

Priya: Messaging A (exec):
- Predictable costs + compliance controls.
- Turnkey hosted or hardened private options.
- One SLAs surface for procurement conversations.

Priya: Messaging B (platform):
- Same API & SDKs across deploy modes.
- Per-route observability & token-cost visibility.
- Built-in fallback routing to preserve uptime.

Len: Inbound routing rules proposal:
- Webinar attendee + demo interest -> AE (enterprise queue) + tag: secure-deploy
- Downloaded asset only -> marketing nurture (3-email sequence)
- Industry = healthcare/finserv -> route to Solutions SE for compliance follow-up
- High-usage demo requests -> trigger ops review for Dedicated sizing
Include these as copy notes on the brief.

Maya: Add a tiny procurement note: pay-as-you-go (hosted), reserved monthly (dedicated), license+support (private). Keep it one line.

Gabe: I'll attach the bench CSV and a one-line test config for the footnote: `model-mid, seq=3072, batch=24, 5k samples`.

ops-bot: Reminder: add SOC2/ISO placeholders when available  https://redwood.example.com/compliance (placeholder).

Len: Design ask: compact three-column table, micro bars for p99, and two small callouts for messaging variants. Will handoff by AM.

Priya: A/B plan: run two subject lines and two CTA wordings in the attendee follow-up email; measure demo clicks and demo bookings over 7 days.

Maya: Good. If no blockers we9ll use Variant A as the gated brief headline and Variant B as the follow-up nurture. Finalize copy by noon tomorrow and hand to design.

Gabe: No blockers. Uploading bench sheet now.

Len: No blockers.

Priya: No blockers.

Maya: Thanks team 680
